name: Kizuna
source:
Your name is Riley, and you are on holiday in the countryside, hoping to pursue your hobby, painting.  As the sun lowers in the sky, you look for a place to spend the night.  Emeline, the owner of the Bed and Breakfast you happen across, is bright-smiled and happy to have you.  As you get to know one another, it seems that something is troubling her.  Do you explore her house and her heart to find all you can, or do you think it's best to leave well enough alone?  Your decisions impact the outcome more than you may realize.  Uncover the secrets of Emeline's family in the visual novel, Kizuna.
 
Contains violence and unsettling themes.

[From [url=http://keysplatter.com/kizuna-game]official site[/url]]
translation:
你的名字叫莱利，你正在乡村度假，希望能够追求你的爱好——绘画。当太阳在天空中落下时，你寻找一个过夜的地方。你碰巧遇到的住宿加早餐旅馆的老板艾米琳 (Emeline) 笑容灿烂，很高兴见到你。随着你们逐渐了解对方，她似乎有什么事情困扰着她。你会探索她的房子和她的内心，尽你所能找到一切，还是你认为最好不要打扰？你的决定对结果的影响超出你的想象。在视觉小说《绊》中揭开艾米琳家族的秘密。
 
包含暴力和令人不安的主题。

[来自[url=http://keysplatter.com/kizuna-game]官方网站[/url]]
